snippet.title: Rogue Fortune | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Rogue Fortune is a single-player, top-down roguelite with a unique, geometric puzzle-powered progression. Greed collides with relentless combat, demanding ever stronger builds and sacrifices. 

Cut through hordes of monsters, arrange Relics into devastating arcane synergies, and gamble your newfound fortune for the strength to escape a temple determined to take it all back.
